We live by six core values:

Freedom

United

Technology

Environment

Career progression opportunities

Represent us professionally on client sites

Assist in delivering complete compliance solutions to our clients

Preventative maintenance

Client interaction

Opportunities to develop skills across other fire protection disciplines
No two days are the same.

result.description:
## Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Cyber Security Advice and Assessment Specialist to join our team and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our organisation's information assets and digital infrastructure. This position is responsible for conducting security assessments, interpreting policies, and delivering expert guidance on cyber security strategies and risk management. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation combined with the ability to communicate complex security concepts to a broad range of stakeholders. This role suits a proactive professional who thrives in dynamic environments and is committed to continuously strengthening an organisation's security posture.
## Key Responsibilities
- Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and security control evaluations to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses across the organisation's systems, networks, and cyber security policies
- Perform vulnerability testing and threat analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations that reduce exposure and strengthen overall defences
- Provide specialist advice and practical guidance on security strategies, helping stakeholders understand and effectively manage identified risks and emerging threats
- Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines that support a robust and consistent organisational security posture
- Lead and support investigations into security incidents, producing clear and thorough reports on findings and guiding the refinement of detection and response processes
- Assist with root cause analysis following security incidents or breaches, assessing the extent of impact and recommending appropriate remedial and preventative actions
- Review and assess information system designs to ensure security requirements are embedded throughout development and implementation lifecycles
- Develop and maintain meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that articulate the impact of cyber security risks on business processes and information assets
- Align and coordinate internal and external audit activities, security assessments, and compliance engagements to ensure consistent and efficient outcomes
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed security best practices across business operations and technology initiatives
- Communicate complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, providing guidance that enables informed decision-making at all levels of the organisation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security role with a focus on risk assessment, security advisory, or security operations
- Strong working knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, ASD Essential Eight, or equivalent
- Proven ability to conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and security control reviews
- Experience developing and implementing security policies, standards, and procedures within a complex organisational environment
- Solid understanding of network security, cloud security principles, identity and access management, and secure system design
- Experience investigating and reporting on security incidents, including root cause analysis and post-incident remediation
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risk and prioritise effectively
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear reports and present findings to diverse audiences
- Familiarity with audit coordination and compliance assessment processes across regulatory or industry frameworks
- Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CompTIA Security+, or CEH
- Experience working within Australian Government security frameworks or with protective security requirements
- Familiarity with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) guidelines and the Information Security Manual (ISM)
- Postgraduate qualifications in Cyber Security, Risk Management, or a related field
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms or other security tooling
- Prior exposure to governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms or tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous learning, and genuine contribution to meaningful security outcomes
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications and training programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance through hybrid arrangements and adaptable scheduling
- Contribute to high-impact work that directly protects critical systems and supports the organisation's strategic objectives
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career growth and advancement within the cyber security function
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

ABOUT US

About Kilcoy Global Foods

Kilcoy Global Foods is a multi-award-winning global foods solutions business, renowned for exceptional quality and innovation. Specialising in premium Australian beef, lamb and high-quality protein products, Kilcoy Global Foods products are enjoyed in more than 50 countries.

 

To learn more about who we are and what we do, visit our website: www.kilcoyglobalfoods.com

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Job Title: Night Shift Maintenance Supervisor

Company Name: Kilcoy Pastoral Company Limited

Location: 4830 D'Aguilar Highway, Winya Queensland 4515. 

Employment Type: Permanent.

Renumeration: $68 - $68.50

To supervise and lead the Night Shift Maintenance team activities for the relevant shift. Deliver reactive and preventative maintenance support to ensure the plant has minimal lost time due to mechanical fault/failure and achieve optimal use of current and future mechanical assets.

Supervising and leading the Maintenance team activities
Delivering preventative and reactive maintenance support
Ensuring the plant has minimal lost time due to mechanical fault/failure
Achieve optimal use of current and future mechanical assets
Administering shift resources appropriately
Working closely with all production managers, other supervisors to deliver quality outcomes
Commitment to the business and the ability to positively react to situations as they may arise, whilst finding the best solution
Maximising employee health and safety
 

 ABOUT YOU

Direct experience in a manufacturing operation, especially meat processing
A proven successful management record in leading a repair and preventative maintenance team.
Computer literacy skills, including Word, Citec.
Experience in MEX or a similar CMMS
Demonstrated capability in effective Contractor management and coordination.
Ability to work through change, drive continuous improvement initiatives and have exceptional communication, negotiation, technical and leadership skills.
Knowledge of and experience in management of refrigeration, waste water, steam generation and environmental technology.
A proven record of driving safety compliance and culture, including but not limited to,  Forklift operations, EWP, working at heights and Confined space training.
Preventative maintenance system experience.
 

QUALIFICATIONS

Trade Qualifications with at least five (5) years relevant experience
Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership and technical skills. 
Experience at a supervisory level, with at least 3 years’ experience managing a team of tradespersons.
Ability to react and prioritize breakdown situations in a production environment which requires downtime to be minimised.
Current driver's license
 

BENEFITS

Access to discounted premium meat
An organisation where cultural diversity is celebrated
Access to discounted health insurance
 

This is a long-term career opportunity, working for an enterprise business with Corporate Offices on the Sunshine Coast in Queensland.  We have recorded business growth of 20% year on year with sales in excess of $3 billion.  We are committed to building a work environment that fosters an agile plus flexible workplace and where employee wellbeing is paramount.

 

HOW TO APPLY

If you are looking to join a company that promotes innovation, is a leader in industry and champions success, then apply now.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and make every effort to select the best qualified individual for the job based on job related qualifications and experiences. Some of the information we collect via your application form and resume is “personal” information as defined by the Privacy Act. All information provided via your application form and resume is treated as confidential.

result.description:
Stonemason – Eastern Creek NSW

Kogan People Solutions is recruiting for a business specialising in the supply and installation of high-end stone products, including marble, porcelain, and other premium materials. The company provides expert fabrication and installation services, blending craftsmanship with the timeless design of products such as benchtops, stairs, and other elegant interiors for residential and commercial clients.

With a strong focus on quality, detail, and aesthetic excellence, they are currently seeking an experienced and qualified Stonemason to join the team. They are seeking a highly motivated individual who can demonstrate the care and attention to detail that this role requires. The role is full-time and ongoing.

Location – work is based in Eastern Creek NSW, with occasional on-site work.

Salary – negotiable in the range of $80k to $85k plus superannuation per annum.

About the role:

This role is based in a busy factory environment and will involve all aspects of factory work required to complete the job and prepare the goods for installation.

Responsibilities of the job include:

•	Expert cutting, shaping, finishing, polishing and handling natural or engineered stone such as marble, porcelain, granite, quartz and other materials.

•	Utilising a range of equipment and machinery to create stone interiors such as benchtops, stairs, splashbacks, sinks and other products.

•	Study and interpret plans, drawings, and specifications to determine materials required, measurements, and appropriate stonemasonry procedures.

•	Reading and interpreting technical drawings and specifications to ensure precise execution of stone products.

•	Mixing required glue and other adhesives to bond stone surfaces securely and ensure proper assembly during fabrication.

•	Operate hand and power tools in a safe and efficient manner, in compliance with company procedures and WHS regulations such as wearing personal protective equipment (PPE), handling materials properly and other safe work procedures.

•	Maintain cleanliness and order in the work area and assist in site clean-up upon project completion.

To be successfully considered, you:

•	Possess relevant trade Certificate III plus 2 years working experience  or Cert IV, ideally in the field of Stonemasonry (or a closely related building trade) or agreed substitute.

•	Have a minimum of 1 or more years working experience in the field, preferably within a factory setting.

•	Have competence and experience in handling masonry tools and materials.

•	Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work from technical drawings.

•	Excellent communication skills to communicate effectively.

•	Possess White Card or willing to obtain before starting work.

•	Excellent team skills, patience, and empathy.

•	Have physical strength and stamina to work with and handle heavy materials.

•	Are prompt and reliable, with excellent time management skills.

•	Are eager to secure a full-time salaried position (so this role is not suitable for sub-contractors)

•	Possess a current driver’s license.

•	Forklift license is preferred but not essential.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV. 

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants. 

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Technosoft Australia

Date Posted: 24 July 2026

Position: ICT Help Desk

Salary: $76,550 - $90,000 per annum plus 12% superannuation

Hours: 38 hours

Mode: Full-time

Location: Level 19, 180 Lonsdale Street, Melbourne VIC 3000

Experience required: Minimum 1 year of relevant ICT support or help desk experience

Technosoft Australia is a growing IT services and digital solutions company specialising in website development, app development, digital strategy, IT support, and business technology solutions for a wide range of clients across Australia. The company provides innovative and reliable technology services with a strong focus on customer satisfaction, technical support, and digital transformation solutions.

We are currently seeking a motivated and skilled ICT Help Desk Officer to join our growing technical support team. This role is ideal for a candidate with strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for providing high-quality IT support services to clients and internal users.

The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical assistance and support related to hardware, software, systems, and network issues while ensuring prompt resolution of technical problems.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Provide first-level technical support to clients and internal staff via phone, email, and remote support tools

•	Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, system, and network-related issues

•	Install, configure, and maintain computer systems, software applications, and peripheral devices

•	Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT staff when required

•	Maintain accurate records of support requests, troubleshooting activities, and system updates

•	Assist with user account management, password resets, and access permissions

•	Support website, application, and system maintenance activities where required

•	Monitor system performance and identify potential technical issues proactively

•	Assist in maintaining IT security standards, backups, and software updates

•	Provide guidance and training to users on basic IT systems and applications

•	Ensure all support tasks are completed within agreed service timeframes

•	Collaborate with internal teams to support ongoing technology projects and improvements

•	Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach when handling support requests

Qualifications:

•	Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, ICT, Computer Science, or related field

•	Minimum 1 year of relevant ICT support or help desk experience

Skills and Other Requirements:

•	Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

•	Knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft Office, networking, and basic server administration

•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills

•	Ability to work independently and within a team environment

•	Strong time management and organisational skills

•	Customer service-focused attitude with the ability to work under pressure

Email your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au

USVD Consultants Pty Ltd (ACN 666 075 065) ABN: 80 993 362 158 is a recruitment company having office at Bella Vista NSW 2153.

Our client APS, Australasian Protective Services (ABN 69 084 470 995) is a Premier Security Company and it is a 100% Australian owned company that provides customisable solutions, including cash in transit, physical manpower presence and technology security solutions to their clients all across Australia. They specialize in tailored electronic security solutions for organizations of all sizes and industries. Electronic security refers to the utilization of advanced technology, such as CCTV cameras, electronic alarm systems, and drone technology, to conduct comprehensive security checks on premises. APS assures safety and security and it is their top priority. 

Due to the business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker(s) in their Technology team on a permanent full-time basis.

Position Title: Electronic Equipment Trades Worker
Location: Laverton North VICTORIA 3026
Reports to: Technology Leader 
No. of position: 02
Offered Salary range: $80,000.00 - $85,000.00 plus Super 

Role purpose:
Electronic Equipment Trades Workers install, maintain and repair electronic equipment and systems such as audio and visual reproduction equipment, home entertainment systems, computers and electronic security systems. As an Electronic Equipment Trades Worker, your duties and responsibilities include:
•	Installing, configuring and commissioning electronic equipment such as CCTV systems, security alarm systems, access control systems, audio-visual equipment, communication systems and electronic control devices.
•	Examining and testing electronic systems and components to diagnose faults using specialised diagnostic tools and electronic testing instruments.
•	Dismantling faulty equipment, identifying defective components and repairing or replacing circuit boards, wiring, connectors, sensors and electronic modules.
•	Reassembling equipment and conducting functional testing to ensure proper performance and compliance with operational specifications.
•	Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams, schematics and technical manuals to perform accurate installation and troubleshooting.
•	Performing routine servicing and preventive maintenance to ensure reliability and reduce equipment failure.
•	Installing and terminating structured cabling and low-voltage wiring systems in accordance with safety regulations.
•	Maintaining documentation including service reports, installation records and compliance documentation.
•	Advising clients and end users on correct system operation, maintenance procedures and safety requirements.
•	Ensuring all work was carried out in compliance with WHS regulations and relevant Australian Standards.

Qualification & Licences:
•	Certificate III in Electronics and Communications or equivalent Tertiary qualifications in Electrical or Electronics engineering.
•	At least 3 years of proven work experience in installing and maintaining electronic equipment or systems. 
•	Strong fault-finding abilities and familiarity with electronic diagnostic tools. 
•	Understanding of WHS requirements, particularly in industrial and construction environments. 
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications.
Skills:
•	Strong organizational and time management skills 
•	Strong problem-solving skills 
•	Excellent attention to detail 
•	Ability to multitask 
•	Process and results driven 
•	Effective communicator, both written and verbal 
•	Team player; collaborative 
•	Resilient, patient and adaptable 
•	Enthusiastic, self-motivated 
•	Proactive 

Additional information: 
•	Ability to work outside of normal business hours on occasion when installing or upgrading components. 
•	Ability to travel interstate, if required.
